changes: saffarid-dynasty: identity.successors: abbasid-caliphate entry removed (the handover has no date field, so it cannot be dated; the 910 return of Fars stays in ledger/24); dossier notes say why
findings.why: A handover carries no date (schema: slug, land, note), so the undated entry made R2 give the Abbasids every conflict cell from 750 on. Saffarid page infobox: 'Succeeded by: Samanid Empire; Ghaznavid Empire' and 'Preceded by: Tahirid dynasty; Abbasid Caliphate; Zunbil dynasty', i.e. the caliphate is no successor; 'Under Tahir ibn Muhammad ibn Amr (901-908), the dynasty fought the Abbasids for the possession of Fars'. The 910 return of Fars is already the ledger loss ledger/24 (counterpart abbasid-caliphate). The 910 sentence quoted in the removed entry is not on this page (it comes from a page of an earlier agent), so the date 910 stays with ledger/24 as it was. The samanid-empire entry is not touched: both dossiers list each other, so the later-born (Saffarid) wins there.

The 23 Inner Mongolia cells Cliopatria's Ming shape draws at the Great Wall remain a Ming-shape question (not this dossier's).

findings.why: The compiler applies R2 from the successor's start year (1721) and a handover has no date field, so the only way to apply the successor's land from the end is to hand the land over by an event: the loss at 1764-10 ('According to a decree issued on 21 October 1764, the hetman's post was officially liquidated'; 'from 1764 to 1781, the Cossack Hetmanate was incorporated as the Little Russia Governorate'). Rule 7 at the dissolve then finds nothing left. The russian-empire dossier lists only tsardom-of-russia as predecessor, so no second R2 link remains; hierarchy.csv has the Hetmanate as vassal of tsardom-of-russia 1654-1720 and of russian-empire 1721-1764, which draws it inside its overlord (R3). Page: infobox 'After 1654: Protectorate of the Tsardom of Moscow and Russian Empire'.

findings.why: Murad Bey page: "Murad fled to Cairo and then Upper Egypt"; "mounted a brief guerrilla warfare that staved off the armies of Louis Desaix for a year"; "In 1800, Murad made peace with Jean-Baptiste Kleber ... He was responsible for collecting taxes from Upper Egypt on behalf of the French First Republic"; died 22 April 1801. Ottoman Egypt page: Ottoman authority returned after Anglo-Turkish forces expelled the French in 1801 and Murad was succeeded by Osman Bey al-Bardisi (territory not described, so the dossier ends at Murad's death). The page names only Upper Egypt, so Sinai (Ibrahim fled toward it) and the coast are not drawn after July 1798 and fall to nobody (the ottoman-empire and french dossiers own their claims); the 1800 peace is not coded as a vassal relation (the page says tax collector for the French First Republic; no dossier slug is named).

changes: bosnia-eyalet: ledger (new, before the dissolve): loss 1878 (no month), counterpart ottoman-empire, country Bosnia and Herz.

bosnia-eyalet: ledger dissolve (1878): counterpart austria-hungary -> ottoman-empire; identity.successors: austria-hungary -> ottoman-empire (Bosnia and Herz.); new source entry for the Condominium page
findings.why: Condominium page: "The Treaty of Berlin caused Bosnia and Herzegovina to nominally remain under sovereignty of the Ottoman Empire"; "The occupation of Bosnia and Herzegovina started on 29 July 1878"; the Bosnia Vilayet "officially remained part of the Ottoman Empire". The dissolve now passes the land to the Ottoman Empire, as asked. I did not add the occupation_start requested for this dossier: the compiler reverses the roles of an occupation_start recorded by the owner (Austria-Hungary would occupy the eyalet's land) and the dissolve then releases occupied land as plain land of the occupier, which is the bug; the austria-hungary dossier already records the occupation of Ottoman land (ledger/2 occupation_start 1878-07, ledger/4 occupation_end 1908-10, ledger/5 gain). Events are applied in month order (month 0 for an event without month), so the loss carries no month and comes before the occupation of July 1878. Patch p1870-p1879 events/1, 2, 3 now duplicate this and should be dropped by the orchestrator.
